title: Rate Review Schedule — Length-of-Residence Relief on the Independent Living Annual Increase Ceiling
content:
The contract ceiling percentage of an annual increase of the Independent Living Residency Agreement monthly service fee is reduced for length of residence.

## Schedule

Length of residence is counted in **whole calendar months from the move-in date to the day the increase is recorded**.

| Whole calendar months in residence | Reduction of the contract ceiling percentage |
|---|---|
| 84 months or more | 1.0 percentage point |
| 36 months or more but fewer than 84 months | 0.5 percentage point |
| Fewer than 36 months | No residence reduction |

The reduction is subtracted from the contract ceiling percentage; it is a number of percentage points, not a percentage of the ceiling.

## Counting whole months

A whole calendar month is complete on the same day number as the move-in date. A resident who moved in on March 10 completes 84 whole months on March 10 seven years later; on March 9 of that year the count is still 83.

| Move-in date (hypothetical) | Day the increase is recorded | Whole months | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| March 10, 2019 | March 9, 2026 | 83 | 0.5 point |
| March 10, 2019 | March 10, 2026 | 84 | 1.0 point |
| January 20, 2023 | January 19, 2026 | 35 | None |
| January 20, 2023 | January 20, 2026 | 36 | 0.5 point |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A contract ceiling of 7.5 percent for a resident with 40 whole months in residence becomes 7.0 percent after the residence reduction of 0.5 percentage point.
